parts.text: Which way treats learning science as extending into observing and doing, not only reading the book?

options.text: He reads the idea, then watches ice melt in two dishes and records which melts first.
He only rereads the same page of the book and does not observe or try anything.
He copies one heading from the book once and says that finishes the learning.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Kiran is studying Chapter 1. He compares two ways of learning the science in this chapter.

part_answers.answer: He takes an idea from the book and checks it by observing and recording a real change.

teacher.key_rationale: Learning science should extend into observing and doing. Timing melting checks an idea; rereading or copying headings alone stays only in the book.
